note: Six Rivers NF campground on a wooded bluff above the Mad River, about 2 miles below Ruth Lake, under Douglas fir and oak; trails lead down to the river. The Forest Service posts a 22-ft trailer limit, though recreation.gov lists sites to 35 ft. Drinking water is not always on; the district advises calling ahead. --Claude
